facts.fact: The Togolese government portal says the July 2026 project to build AI models for 50 national languages, with Togo AI Lab, Zindi and Umbaji, falls within Togo's national AI strategy, treating it as an existing framework; no adopting act or date is named.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation

facts.fact: At the 13-15 November 2024 'Autour de l'IA' event, the Minister of Digital Economy said Togo needs a national AI strategy to give structure to its AI vision, implying none was in place; no drafting is mentioned.

note: It refers to a national AI strategy in passing but does not state its adoption, a body or funding.

facts.fact: Tic Infos reports Togo's digital-economy ministry launched a call for AI experts to take part in drafting a national AI strategy, with registrations open to 18 October.
TechReviewAfrica reports that Togo is expected to validate its national AI strategy through a government seminar in April 2026, per World Bank director Michel Rogy's account of a Lome mission.
The Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation held a feedback workshop on 19 December 2025 on the work to draw up Togo's National AI Strategy, which rests on six pillars.

facts.fact: Togo's finance ministry page says the country is actively preparing a national Artificial Intelligence Strategy, alongside an international Data Lab and a Maison de l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Togo Officiel reports that the Ministry of Digital Economy called on experts, business leaders, consultants and researchers on 3 October 2024 to register by 18 October and take part in drawing up Togo's national AI strategy, under programme 9 of the Togo Digital strategy.

note: The article gives an AI readiness index and a pilot of language tools, naming no AI strategy.
